name: Ornith 1.0
description: DeepReinforce's open-weights family of self-scaffolding models optimized for agentic coding, post-trained on Gemma 4 and Qwen 3.5.
keyFeatures: Self-scaffolding training framework utilizing reinforcement learning (RL) to learn solution and harness logic
Spans compact 9B/31B dense models up to 35B and 397B MoE frontier sizes
Context window expandable up to 1M tokens via YaRN RoPE scaling
curatorNotes: Deduplicated from Ollama and Hugging Face collection URLs. A self-scaffolding RL coding model designed to run locally.
